data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 鸟白岛防波堤的碧海孤影
data.description: 鸟白岛湛蓝无垠的海岸线防波堤上，海风吹拂。白羽单手按着白色草帽走在长长的堤坝边缘，纯白吊带棉裙轻拂小腿，身后是辽阔的大海与洁白浪花。
data.location: long concrete ocean breakwater surrounded by glittering turquoise sea waters under open summer sky
data.action: walking along narrow seawall, holding straw sun hat with one hand, gazing toward distant sea horizon with calm wistful violet eyes
data.lighting: 盛夏明丽艳阳与海面波光粼粼
data.promptProse: Shiroha walks along the ocean seawall holding her straw hat, looking out over the turquoise island waters with calm wistful purple eyes.
data.animaCaption: Sparkling sea glare and ocean wind whip her white sundress along the edge of the seawall.
